purpose: Two unique conceptual illustrations for the owner-requested Puranic creation page

assets.brief: A complete luminous golden cosmic egg above still primordial indigo waters; restrained antique-gold halo and mineral-pigment/Indian-miniature influence. No deity, letters, logos, scientific diagram, explosion or invented yantra. Conceptual interpretation rather than literal reconstruction.
assets.review: Complete egg and reflection, coherent painting; no anatomical deity claims. Not reused elsewhere as visible artwork.

assets.brief: An imagined river valley at first dawn with distinct plants, an open lotus, two small deer and a few birds; museum-publication painting in parchment, sage, teal and antique gold. No god, human, egg, sequence diagram or letters. Represents differentiated life, not biological evolution or an exact scriptural scene.
assets.review: Two distinct deer, coherent limbs, birds and lotus; no deity iconography. Not reused elsewhere as visible artwork.
